race.title: Try Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap
race.verdict: PALLADAS looked an exciting prospect when winning his first 2 starts on all-weather, including over C&D, and can resume his progress back up to 1m faced with more exposed rivals. Having been gelded, Princling shaped encouragingly when an unlucky third at Ascot last time and is another 3-y-o to note, while Hard Endeavor has a C&D win to his name and should be suited by the drop back to this trip. PALLADAS PRINCLING HARD ENDEAVOR (FR)
